title: The Lion Guard
description: Simba’s son, Kion, assembles a group of animals to protect the Pride Lands, known as the Lion Guard.

episodes.title: S1-E1Never Judge a Hyena By Its Spots

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x1
episodes_data.description: When Kion gets separated from the rest of the Lion Guard, he finds himself lost in the Outlands where he meets Jasiri, a friendly female hyena, who rescues him and helps face off against Janja and the other hyenas.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x2
episodes_data.description: When a crocodile named Makuu takes over as leader of the crocodiles and his aggressive antics send the Pride Lands into chaos, Kion questions whether to intervene or respect animal traditions.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x3
episodes_data.description: After floodwaters threaten the Pride Lands and Bunga comes up with a quick fix, Kion and the other members of the Lion Guard learn that the quick and easy solution to a problem is not always the best.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x4
episodes_data.description: When Simba leaves Kiara in charge of Pride Rock for the first time, Kion reluctantly agrees to obey her which proves difficult when Janja tries to take advantage of Kiara’s inexperience and hatches a plot to take over the Pride Lands.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x5
episodes_data.description: Ono temporarily loses vision in one eye and questions his value to the Lion Guard as the "keenest of sight."

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x6
episodes_data.description: Kion inadvertently leads a pack of jackals into the Pride Lands, where they wreak havoc during a highly regarded Pride Lands ceremony. Ana Gasteyer (ABC’s “The Goldbergs”) guest stars as Rairai, the clever and scheming matriarch to a family of jackals.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x7
episodes_data.description: The Guard thinks that Fuli is lonely since she spends so much time on her own; they try to include her in their family time.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x8
episodes_data.description: Fuli learns a lesson in teamwork when she takes on a mission alone and overexerts herself, leaving her defenseless against attacking vultures.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x9
episodes_data.description: Beshte rescues a young elephant that idolizes him after he wanders into danger.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x10
episodes_data.description: The Lion Guard steps in when they encounter a deceptive drongo bird named Tamaa who mimics predators to scare off smaller animals.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x11
episodes_data.description: Believing that Rafiki's paintings predict the future, Bunga enlists the rest of the Lion Guard to save Kion from danger.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x12
episodes_data.description: Kion and the Guard must lead a large herd through the Outlands to find a less crowded grazing ground.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x13
episodes_data.description: When Bunga and Simba are trapped underground, they discover a shared family background – they were both raised by Timon and Pumbaa.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x14
episodes_data.description: When Beshte befriends a shy okapi, the Lion Guard thinks Beshte has an imaginary friend

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x15
episodes_data.description: The Lion Guard mistakenly chase off aardwolves instead of hyenas and the Pride Lands become overrun with termites.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x16
episodes_data.description: The Lion Guard helps a leopard named Badili stand up to a bully who is challenging his territory.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x17
episodes_data.description: Janja replaces Chungu and Cheezi with two new hyenas in an attempt to sideline the Lion Guard.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x18
episodes_data.description: The Lion Guard rescues a baby baboon and Fuli returns the baboon to its mother.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x19
episodes_data.description: When tales of a mysterious creature plague the Pride Lands, the Guard must conquer their fears and track down the elusive beast.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x20
episodes_data.description: The Lion Guard must choose whether to side with the hyenas or the lions when Jasiri, the good hyena, asks for help.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x21
episodes_data.description: Fearing he has lost control of his roar, Kion vows to never use it again.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x22
episodes_data.description: The Guard helps two buffoonish Gorilla princes return to their home in the snowy Rwenzori Mountains.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x23
episodes_data.description: While Nala takes Kion and Kiara on a trip to teach them the importance of working together, Simba is left in charge of the Lion Guard.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x24
episodes_data.description: Ono meets his idol, legendary eagle Hadithi, and learns that his hero isn't what he expected.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x25
episodes_data.description: Beshte's dad is injured while creating "Hippo Lanes," so Beshte must step in and take over the job.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 1x26
episodes_data.description: While Ono fills in as a Rhino's seeing-eye bird, the rest of the Lion Guard helps by getting the rhino and tick-bird to resolve their differences.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x1
episodes_data.description: The rest of the Lion Guard is stunned when Bunga becomes the go-to babysitter for all the Pride Lands' parents.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x2
episodes_data.description: While Simba gathers the animal leaders for a Savannah Summit, the Lion Guard learns of a plot against Twiga the giraffe.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x3
episodes_data.description: The Lion Guard chase away a baboon comedy troupe that has been distracting the other animals with their antics and stealing their food.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x4
episodes_data.description: Ono begrudgingly becomes the protector of a cuckoo bird's egg left in his nest and chases off an African harrier hawk who has come to the Pride Lands to hunt for tasty new treats.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x5
episodes_data.description: The Guard meets Rafiki's new apprentice Monkiki. Meanwhile, Ushari and the hyenas team up to seek the help of the Pride Lands' greatest villain, Scar.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x6
episodes_data.description: After the Lion Guard accidentally wakes the aestivating crocodiles, the crocs are furious they have to suffer through the dry season!

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x7
episodes_data.description: When Beshte ends up alone in the Outlands, Scar uses the opportunity to attack the Lion Guard's strongest member.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x8
episodes_data.description: When a noisy bachelor herd moves in next door to Rafiki's tree, the Lion Guard try to help the animals find new homes.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x9
episodes_data.description: When Jasiri and two hyena cubs are in danger in the Outlands, the Guard enlists the help of Thurston the Zebra to repel a tsetse fly infestation slowing down their rescue efforts.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x10
episodes_data.description: Makini and the Guard are excited to attend their first Ukumbusho but bees threaten to ruin the important celebration!

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x11
episodes_data.description: To help the hyenas steal melons, a Monitor Lizard bites Kion, Fuli and Beshte which temporarily paralyzes them!

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x12
episodes_data.description: Bunga and the Lion Guard enlist the help of other animals to perform "The Twelve Ways of Christmas" so Timon and Pumbaa can have a "real" Christmas.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x13
episodes_data.description: When Scar has the hyenas trap and interrogate Zazu, the Guard must rescue him.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x14
episodes_data.description: Facing a water shortage in the Pride Lands, the Lion Guard must appease zebra leader, Dhahabu, to gain access to a new watering hole.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x15
episodes_data.description: Beshte makes friends with a little gecko named Hodari who wants to be a crocodile more than anything else in the world!

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x16
episodes_data.description: When the guard is up against two attacks at once, Kion enlists the help of Tamaa the Drongo to help them be in two places at once.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x17
episodes_data.description: After a scorpion sent by Scar stings Simba, the Guard needs to face every villain in the Outlands to get a cure for the king!

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x18
episodes_data.description: Fuli and Makini are tasked with escorting one of the Pride Lands' wisest animals, a tortoise named Kongwe, back to Pride Rock to meet with the King.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x19
episodes_data.description: After Scar's minions set fire to the Kilio Valley, the misplaced elephants are forced to the Pride Lands and create chaos amongst the other herds.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x20
episodes_data.description: A color-changing chameleon named Kinyonga helps the Guard by spying on Scar in the Outlands.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x21
episodes_data.description: After discovering a mysterious cave that may hold the key to defeating Scar, the Guard must face dangerous hazards to uncover its secrets.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x22
episodes_data.description: After hearing Thurston boast that he's the brains behind the Lion Guard, the villains of the Outlands capture him to find a way to defeat the Guard.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x23
episodes_data.description: Jasiri offers to help the Guard battle Scar by forming a Hyena Resistance in the Outlands.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x24
episodes_data.description: Kion, Kiara, Bunga, Tiifu and Zuri must journey underground through aardvark tunnels to escape a fire.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x25
episodes_data.description: A gorilla warrior named Shujaa comes to help the Lion Guard in the battle against Scar.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x26
episodes_data.description: Kion, is tasked with gathering the Pride Landers to prepare them for their fight against Scar.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x27
episodes_data.description: After being threatened by Scar's attacks, Queen Dhahabu asks Fuli, Tiifu and Zuri to become her permanent personal guards.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x28
episodes_data.description: Scar makes an appearance when Timon and Pumbaa decide to put on a show in Mizimu Grove.

episodes_data.title: The Lion Guard 2x29
episodes_data.description: To combat the vultures dropping flame sticks from the sky, the Lion Guard seeks help from Hadithi and a Martial eagle named Anga.
